About Us

The story behind Atang
Tracing

Born from a commitment to justice and financial inclusion, Atang Tracing Services bridges the gap between unclaimed benefits and the people they belong to.

Trusted by funds, insurers & estate practitioners

Atang Tracing Services was founded by two professionals who witnessed firsthand how unclaimed benefits quietly erode the financial security of South African families. Their answer was a specialist firm built on ethical tracing, regulatory precision, and genuine care for beneficiaries.

Today we serve pension funds, insurers, and estate administrators across the country, delivering auditable end-to-end tracing that meets FSCA, POPIA, and PAIA requirements at every stage.

"To reunite beneficiaries with their entitlements and reconnect legacies with the people they were meant for."
— Atang Tracing Services Mission Statement
Our Values

The principles that guide every trace

Ethical Standards
Every engagement follows strict professional codes of conduct. Beneficiaries are treated with dignity and respect.
Human-Centred
Behind every case is a person or family. We never lose sight of the human impact of our work.
Precision & Accuracy
Multi-source verification eliminates errors and ensures only confirmed information reaches our reports.
Transparency
Clients receive full visibility into our process, documentation, and outcomes at every milestone.
Stakeholder Trust
We build long-term relationships with fund administrators, trustees, auditors, and regulators.
Legal Compliance
Full POPIA, PAIA, and FSCA alignment. Our processes are designed to hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

What We Do

Core Tracing Services

End-to-end tracing solutions for the South African financial sector — transparent, auditable, and fully aligned with regulatory obligations.

Core Service

Beneficiary Identification & Verification

Multi-source identity verification against national databases, civil records, and biometric ID tools. We confirm authentic connections between individuals and their unclaimed entitlements with documented precision.

National database cross-referencing
Biometric ID verification
Civil records checks
Documented evidence trail
Data Management

Data Validation & Cleansing

Comprehensive audits that identify gaps, inaccuracies, and duplications in your member or beneficiary records. Clean, validated data dramatically improves trace success rates and reduces compliance risk.

Duplicate record detection
Gap analysis reporting
Data quality scoring
Corrected output delivery
Outreach

Contact Tracing & Multi-channel Outreach

Systematic outreach via phone, SMS, email, and field tracing. Every contact attempt is documented and timestamped, providing your fund with a complete, auditable record of all engagement activity.

Phone & SMS campaigns
Field tracing services
Email communication
Full attempt logging
Reporting

Compliance Reporting & Documentation

Comprehensive trace reports supporting FSCA, auditor, and trustee review. Each report demonstrates due diligence, documents outcomes, and provides the evidence base required to satisfy regulatory obligations.

FSCA-aligned reporting
Trustee-ready documentation
Auditor evidence packs
Outcome summaries
What Sets Us Apart

Why administrators choose Atang

Professionalism matters as much as success rates. Our edge lies in how we trace — and how we report.

Digital Tracing Methods
Multi-source digital searches across national databases, social records, and real-time lookups — faster and more accurate than legacy approaches.
Rural & Township Capability
Field agent network with proven reach into rural communities and townships where traditional contact methods consistently fail.
Multilingual Tracing Support
Tracing conducted in all 11 official South African languages — removing language as a barrier to successful beneficiary engagement.
Deceased Estate Expertise
Specialist capability in death benefit tracing, next-of-kin identification, and estate beneficiary verification.
Real-Time Reporting Dashboards
Live progress visibility so fund managers and trustees always know exactly where each trace stands — no chasing for updates.
High-Volume Handling
Scalable capacity to manage large member lists without compromising accuracy, turnaround times, or documentation quality.

FSCA Aligned POPIA Compliant Fully Documented Auditable at Every Step
01
Data
Assessment

We begin by reviewing your beneficiary or member data — assessing quality, identifying missing records, duplicates, and contact gaps. A clear baseline allows us to prioritise and plan the trace efficiently.

Data quality audit
Gap identification
Prioritisation framework
Kick-off reporting
02
Tracing &
Verification

Using multi-source tools — national databases, credit bureaux, CIPC, DHA records, and field networks — we locate individuals and verify their connection to the unclaimed benefit. Every step is documented.

National database queries
Field tracing network
Identity verification
Source documentation
03
Beneficiary
Engagement

Once located, we make contact through ethical, POPIA-compliant outreach — phone, SMS, email, or in person. We guide beneficiaries through the claims process, making it as simple and stress-free as possible.

Multi-channel contact
POPIA-compliant scripts
Claims process guidance
Engagement logging
04
Reporting &
Handover

A comprehensive report is delivered covering all cases — located, contacted, outstanding, and exceptions. The report meets FSCA requirements and includes supporting evidence for trustee and auditor review.

Full outcome report
FSCA evidence pack
Trustee-ready summary
Handover documentation

Every step is fully auditable.

Our process is documented, timestamped, and verifiable — providing your fund with the evidence needed to satisfy FSCA and external auditor requirements.
